name: Børk the Berzerker Hack ‘N’ Slash Edition
review:
Børk the Berzerker Hack 'N' Slash Edition is a 5-reel fantasy slot about a barbarian saving his beloved from an evil magician, with expanding wilds and a bonus game.

Thunderkick lists a 97.3% RTP and a 2,100x cap. It publishes a numeric volatility value instead of a label, so we don't show a rating.
pros: Excellent 97.30% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Thunderkick doesn't publish a volatility label for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
